record.name: Aircall
record.one_liner: A cloud-based business phone system and customer communications platform with call center tools and AI voice agents.
record.access_note: Aircall requires a paid subscription plan to access the Public API.
record.api_note: The REST API covers calls, contacts, users, teams, phone numbers, comments, tags, and webhooks.

evidence.quote: With Aircall Public API, Authentication can be done through OAuth or Basic Auth.
All plans include API access and 250+ integrations.
Aircall Public API is a classic REST API.
MCP Server for Aircall API — 73 tools for calls, contacts, SMS

auth.why: Docs list OAuth and Basic Auth, no API key support.

access.why: API access listed for all plans, not limited to paid only.

mcp.why: Third‑party GitHub repo provides an Aircall MCP server.

verdict.why: Auth claim incorrect; API key not supported.
